read.en: Applied Optoelectronics rose 7.0% on Oct 27 to $76.95, trading between $71.08 and $77.28. It is above the falling 5-day ($72.4) and 10-day ($76.2) averages and below the falling 30-day ($96.3) and 100-day ($117.4) and the rising 200-day ($113.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($90.53), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: Applied Optoelectronics 10月27日上涨 7.0%，收于 $76.95，盘中区间 $71.08–77.28。股价位于下行的 5 日（$72.4）和 10 日均线（$76.2）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$96.3）和 100 日均线（$117.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$113.5）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$90.53），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close cleared $73.3 and $76 (Jul 29 low, 10-day), now support. Resistance is $77.3 (Oct 27 high), then $80.5–81.3 (Oct 19 and 21 highs) and $90.5 (SAR). Support is $76–76.2, then $71.1–72.4 (Oct 23 high, Oct 27 low, 5-day) and $66.3–66.5 (Oct 22 and 26 lows). A close above $77.3 would target $80.5–81.3; below $76, $71–72.
